description: Wave-2 S2 (fast codec + adaptive in-flight + memory budget): one route, 1 KB, 1-min steps (20 s warm-up, s2-explore method). Cases p1/p12 with the default (auto) in-flight limit and with maxInFlight 5000 (auto, cap 5000). Run once per ROUTER_ENGINE_CODEC (fast, tree); results are renamed wave2-s2-<codec>.json.
